reflection.title: What could make a search fail?
reflection.body: These words connect an unsuccessful search with turning away from ourselves and our nature. What is being sought remains unspecified.
reflection.question: What assumptions about yourself shape the questions you ask?
reflection.grounding: The question above is a present-day prompt. It starts from the conditional link in this excerpt between seeking, failing to obtain, and departing from ourselves and our nature.
reflection.limits: This short excerpt does not define our nature or identify the object of the search. It does not establish a general instruction to follow personal feelings. The surrounding argument is incomplete.
reflection.reference: PHerc. 1667, Column XVII, selected words in lines 1–6
